book.name: HEBREWS
book.title: HEBREW sinmuy amuṅaqw Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēni

content: Noqw itam hihta pay tutuqayyaqey qa pūvut‐sa yuaatotat, momi hóyokye’ tukwsiwwisni. Itam pay itahhintsakpiy itamumi qahimuniwhtiqat aṅqw lasyaqe God qapēvewnaya.

Pu itam pay kūyit akw tuvoylatiwhqat hihta tuawi’taqat nanapta; pu Hikwsi hakiy hin öqalmaqaṅwuqat itam pay navoti’yuṅwa. Pu so’pum ahoy yesvaniqat hak itamuy pay tutuqayna. Pu God sohsokmuy itamuṅem sūs hin yúkuniqat itam pay tuwi’vaya.
Noqw yahpiy pu’ itam hihta akw öqawhtotaniqey putwatyani, kurs God pan itamuṅem yuki’taniq’ö.
Pi uma sūs unaṅwtalawvaya, pu ōveqatsit aṅqw hihta kuwahtiput aṅqw yukuya, pu Qahováriwtaqat Hikwsit nuhtum makiwya,
Pu soñawnen God lavayiyat lolmat aṅqw yukuya, pu qatsit nātoniqat ep hīhihta öqalat aṅq’ö.
Nīk̇aṅw kurs uma God pöhuyat aṅqw lasyaqw, kurs hak umuy God aw ahoy tsamvani. Soñawnen pi uma nankiwakw God Tiyat piw nahoylehtsit aw muayat, nuhtutpik put hamantoynayani.
Pi tutskwat aw qa sūs yokvaqw, pam mowaiwk̇aṅw, piw put tumalay’yuṅqamuy amuṅem hihta aniwnaṅwunihqa God unaṅwveniṅwu.
Nīk̇aṅw i’ himu tsutskuy’yuṅqa pu kūtay’yuṅqa pay ayo yukiwṅwu, nihqe pāpu pay maspiwniqe, ōviy taqtsokiwṅwu.
Nīk̇aṅwo, aw iunaṅwam itupkomu, nāmahin pi as nu yan hiṅqawk̇aṅw qa pas pas umuy tuawi’ta, nīk̇aṅw nu umuy qapēvewna, pi hak ayo yámakqey hin qátuṅwuqat uma pan yēse.
Noqw God qa hihta ep qasuantaqe umuhtumalay soon qa tunatyawtani. Pi uma put aw unaṅway’yuṅqe ōviy sinomuyatuy amumi unaṅwtavi’yuṅwa, piw nāt amumi unaṅwtavi’wisa.
Noqw uma yūmosa nānani unaṅway’yuṅwniqat nu okiw as nāwakna, nen uma umuh’ahsatiy sohsok ömahtotani, pu umuh’unaṅwvahsiy aw yórikyani.
Ura hakim God awiniyat qapēvewnayaqe qa naṅ’eknayat, pas antsa unaṅwvahsiy aw yórikya. Noqw pan piw uma qapēvewnayak̇ahk̇aṅw qa naṅ’eknayani.
God’s Sure Promise
Pi ura God Abraham aw hihta pasiwnaqe kurs hakiy pas pávannihqat aw yank̇aṅw öqalat lavayhtiniqe nāp tuṅwniy aw yank̇aṅw lavayhtiqe,
Paṅqawu: Pay nu pas nāp soon uṅ qa hahlayhtapne’, öqawhtoynani, pu uṅ natkotoynani, kita.
Noqw ōviy pam qa yāvaiwk̇aṅw aṅ kuyvaqe put aw awinit aw yori.
Pi sino hakiy pávannihqat aw yank̇aṅw qaöwílvayhtiniqw pahsat pay puma lavayiy sohtapnayaṅwu.
Noqw ōviy God itamuy paaṅwaniqey itamuy āawnaqe nāp natṅwaniy aw yank̇aṅw qaöwilvayhti. Noqw ōviy pam tunatyay pas soon qa alöṅtaniqat itam navoti’yuṅwni.
Pam awiniy, piw lavayiy soon alöṅtani, pu pas soon atsátani; noqw ōviy itam put aw taqa’naṅwtotiqe watqaqam wūkoq unaṅwtote’ God hin itamuy āawnaqey pan itamuy ayo óyaniqat itam navoti’yuṅwa.
It yan unaṅwvahsit itam pasiwyuṅwa, pu put aw yank̇ahk̇aṅw itam hūrs hoṅni; pi pam pas qa hinwat hinhtiṅwu. Christ hapi aw itam yanyuṅwa, hakiy ōveqatsit ep qátuhqat aw’i.
Pam itamuhsavo paṅsoq pákihqe, itamuṅem Nay aw naokiwlawu. Pi pam Melchisedec tuwiyat ahpiy God awwat susmohpeq sūs moṅwtaviwa.
